subject: Re: CloudNorth 2027 — satellite demo studio & visibility terms
messages:
From: Sophie Hart <sophie@cloudnorth.com>
To: sean_gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Andrew Miller <andrew@cloudnorth.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Jan 2027 09:23:00 -0500
Subject: CloudNorth 2027 — proposed satellite demo studio & visibility

Hi Sean,

Great speaking with Andrew earlier — following up with a concrete package we think could work for Redwood. Rather than only a booth, CloudNorth is piloting a small satellite demo studio this year (adjacent to the expo floor) designed for product walk-throughs and short recorded demos. High level: 

- Sponsor package: $45,000 (base) + $12,000 for the satellite demo studio add-on.
- Satellite demo studio: 15x15 footprint, basic AV (camera + mixer), small staging area with 2 chairs, branded overhead panel, and a 20-min timed session schedule for demo rotations.
- Visibility: tiered logo placement (bronze placement on site map, silver on expo banner, gold on main stage aprons). If you take the demo studio add-on you get elevated logo on satellite signage and one dedicated 30-sec pre-roll on the expo stream.
- Speaking: 1x 30-min workshop slot included with the studio add-on; main-stage micro-keynote (10 min) is available at +$8,000 and is subject to availability.
- Lead sharing: CSV export for sponsors within 72 hours of event with GDPR opt-in flags removed (we mask email addresses for EU attendees unless explicit opt-in).
- Contract: draft available, but note our standard exclusivity clause is category-based (AI/ML infrastructure) and usually limited to on-site exclusivity only (not virtual).

I've attached the sponsor pack with floorplan and typical deliverables. If Redwood is interested we can hold the demo studio until 2027-01-20 for signature.

Attachment: CloudNorth_Sponsor_Pack_v4.pdf
Attachment: floorplan_satellite_studio.png

Would love to hear what matters most to you — brand prominence, speaking time, lead timing — and we can try to match.

Best,
Sophie Hart
Head of Partnerships, CloudNorth Events
Sophie.hart@cloudnorth.com

---

From: sean_gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Hart <sophie@cloudnorth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 09 Jan 2027 12:05:00 -0500
Subject: Re: CloudNorth 2027 — proposed satellite demo studio & visibility

Hi Sophie — thanks for the summary and attachments. A few quick clarifying questions before we review with Finance/Legal: 

1) Satellite studio footprint + AV: can you confirm whether the studio includes a dedicated AV tech for the day or if that is sponsor-provided? If it’s included, what are the hours covered?
2) Logo placement tiers: can you be explicit about pixel sizes/placement on the expo banner vs. satellite signage? We want to understand the relative prominence.
3) Lead share: 72 hours is good; can we get raw contact data for US attendees (name, title, company, email) and a separate GDPR-compliant CSV for EU? We need a contractual guarantee for delivery SLA.
4) Speaking fallback: if your main-stage keynote is added and the speaker cancels, what's the fallback? Can we contractually reserve a backup workshop slot?

On value: we’re definitely interested in the demo studio — it's attractive for product motion — but the combined price is higher than our current sponsorship budget for Q1/Q2 events. If CloudNorth can include the main-stage 10-min micro-keynote at no additional fee in exchange for top-tier logo placement on the expo banner and a second 30-min workshop slot, I think we can bridge the gap. Alternatively, a 15% discount on the combined package would work.

Please send a draft agreement or change summary and I’ll loop in Legal (CCing Dev Patel for contract redlines) and Marketing (Laura & Marissa) to confirm on staffing.

Attachment: redlines_request.docx

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Head of Field Marketing, Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0192

---

From: Sophie Hart <sophie@cloudnorth.com>
To: sean_gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Andrew Miller <andrew@cloudnorth.com>
Date: Sat, 10 Jan 2027 10:15:00 -0500
Subject: Re: CloudNorth 2027 — proposed satellite demo studio & visibility

Sean — thanks for the quick note and great questions. Answers below: 

1) AV & tech: the studio includes a shared AV tech who will be on site during expo hours (08:00–18:00) and will support the scheduled demo rotations. Any custom recording/editing beyond live switching is sponsor-responsibility.
2) Logo specs: expo banner (main hall apron) — 6000px width, top-tier logos get 800px width x 200px height; satellite signage — 400px x 120px. We'll mark your logo as gold-level on satellite signage if you take the studio.
3) Lead share: we can provide a US raw CSV (name, title, company, email) within 48 hours if requested in contract; EU attendee emails will be masked unless explicit opt-in is captured. We will add a service-level clause with the 48-hour delivery window.
4) Speaking fallback: we can guarantee a backup 30-min workshop slot if the main-stage item is canceled, but the backup workshop will be scheduled within the same expo day and is subject to room availability. We'll put a clause in the agreement to that effect.

On pricing: we can offer a 10% discount on the combined package if Redwood commits to the demo studio plus two workshop slots (one included + one additional). For the main-stage micro-keynote at no charge, we can offer it as a limited concession if you sign by 2027-01-18 and accept the discount. Otherwise the micro-keynote is +$8,000.

DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/REDWOOD-CloudNorth-Agreement-2027

Attachment: floorplan_satellite_studio.png

Let me know if you want me to mark up the draft with the 48-hour lead SLA and the backup workshop clause. We’re happy to hold the demo studio until 2027-01-20 pending a signature.

Best,
Sophie

---

From: sean_gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 10 Jan 2027 14:48:00 -0500
Subject: Re: CloudNorth 2027 — proposed satellite demo studio & visibility

Team — quick internal sync before I reply to Sophie. TL;DR: studio + two workshops with 10% discount + free 10-min micro-keynote if we sign by 1/18. Key asks and next steps: 

- Marketing (Laura/Marissa): can you confirm we can staff the 15x15 studio for the expo days (2 FTEs per shift + 1 floater) and run two 30-min workshops? Also confirm we can produce a 30-sec pre-roll asset for the expo stream.
- Legal (Dev): need quick read on the exclusivity clause (category-based). Can we carve out API-level mentions? Also pls confirm the wording for the 48-hour lead delivery SLA and the EU mask/opt-in handling. We should add a penalty (credit) if they miss the SLA.
- Sales/Rev (Grace): is there any reason this would conflict with existing pipeline deals or channel partners? Also confirm whether the lead data in the CSV feeds into our CRM mapping process (we need a prefixed tag for event leads).
- Finance: the committed spend after discount would be ~ $50.4k (45k + 12k - 10%). Is there an existing budget in FY27 events? If not, can we use Q1 field marketing budget or move funds from paid ads?

Counter suggestion for negotiation: ask for explicit post-event reporting (attendee engagement minutes per demo rotation) and an additional $2k credit toward a future event if they miss the 48-hour SLA. If they push back, accept the 10% discount but insist on the backup-workshop fallback by contract and the raw US CSV within 48 hours.

I’ll wait 24 hours for confirmations and then I’ll reply to Sophie to accept the 10% if everything checks out.

Attachment: internal_playbook_notes.txt

—Sean
